observation_summary: Function parameters were being removed during compilation, causing the 'length' property of functions to change unexpectedly.
reasoning_summary: The compiler was aggressively removing unused function parameters even when the compilation level was set to 'SIMPLE_OPTIMIZATIONS'. This optimization is problematic because it changes the 'length' property of functions, which is relied upon by some JavaScript code (e.g., for currying). The fix introduces a conditional check to ensure that unused function arguments are only removed when global variable removal is enabled, preventing this side effect in simpler compilation modes.
